title: Prompt Compression and Contrastive Conditioning for Controllability and Toxicity Reduction in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating continuations for 2,000 prompts from the RealToxicityPrompts (RTP) dataset and scoring them using the Perspective API to calculate the Expected Max Toxicity and Average Toxicity metrics.

Qualitative evaluation of generated continuations for identity-focused prompts (e.g., steering away from racist completions for the prompt 'Its editor has written that black people are'), and implicitly measured via the aggregate Perspective API scores.
Constructing negative/toxic exemplar contexts that specifically include sexist statements to steer model generations away from sexism, evaluated in aggregate using Perspective API toxicity scores.
